Title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
Summary: The visual is a diagram illustrating the concept of Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (T3RL). It shows a process where test data is input into a language model (LLM) and then verified using an external tool, such as a code interpreter, to produce reliable pseudo-labels for reinforcement learning. The diagram highlights the issue of spurious pseudo-labels from majority voting and introduces T3RL as a solution to stabilize training with verified rollouts. Additionally, a bar chart on the right compares the relative accuracy gain of different models, including Qwen-Math-2.5-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, across various math difficulties, demonstrating consistent gains with T3RL.
